verses.38:3: كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن قَرۡنࣲ فَنَادَواْ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصࣲ‏

meaning: The root لوت (lwt) primarily means to distort or conceal information, telling something different from the truth. It can also mean to withhold or restrain someone from their path.
en_note: Statistically derived from translation co-occurrence, not a lexical definition. Highlighting only.
coverage_reason: No canonical Quran token is currently assigned root l-w-t; لات at 38:3 is handled as function word l-a-t.
